provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Radnor, Chapter 280 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code RA0484): includes legislation through 09-28-2026. New Laws lists two ordinances, for Chapter 250 and Chapter 270. Neither touches zoning. The chapter was read in the eCode360 print view in a browser.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 09-28-2026. New Laws (2), none for Chapter 280.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit or accessory apartment rule for house lots. R-1 to R-4 list single-family detached dwellings, a few special exceptions and listed accessory uses (280-14, 280-17.2, 280-19, 280-24, 280-29)
A dwelling unit may have 'not more than one kitchen' and a family is one housekeeping unit (280-4). A second kitchen unit is a second dwelling unit
Uses the code does not define go to R-6 or PA only, by conditional use, after a Zoning Officer determination (280-130.1). In R-1 to R-4 a second unit needs a use variance
AC district only: a tenant house is a listed accessory use on a lot of at least four acres. It houses tenant farmers or employees of a farm or estate (280-9H(3), 280-4)

Conversion of a house to two units is a special exception in AC, R-1 and R-2 (280-108), and in R-3 by reference (280-24B(1)). Each unit needs the district single-family lot area and at least 600 sq ft. No exterior extension
Two-family detached dwellings are permitted in R-5. Lot area 5,445 sq ft per family, 80 ft wide (280-34C, 280-35A(1))
Parking: two spaces per dwelling unit (280-103B(1))
Rental units need an annual license from the township, with inspections (226-7)
Accessory buildings: 20 ft high, 10 ft from the house. Side and rear 10 ft in R-1 to R-3, 3 ft in R-4, 20 ft in AC (280-12, 280-17, 280-22, 280-27, 280-32)
Garrett Hill GH-GA lists a 'Commercial structure containing one accessory dwelling unit' as a mixed use (280-49.7). That is a unit in a commercial building, not a backyard unit
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Community Development Department, https://www.radnor.com/government/departments/community-development. Searched Chapter 280 for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder, ECHO, carriage, guest, servant, caretaker, secondary dwelling, accessory living, second dwelling, accessory residential, living quarters, kitchen, tenant house. Pending: no zoning amendment on the New Laws list.

term.note: No ADU term for house lots. The nearest is 'TENANT HOUSE: An accessory building on a lot, used ... as a residence ... for ... tenant farmers or employees of a farm or estate.' AC only.

status.note: Reading of a silent code. Residence districts list no second unit. The AC tenant house is for farm or estate employees on four acres or more, so it is a district path, not the town rule.

path.note: 'Residential uses shall only be allowed in the R-6 or PA Districts.' A second unit is not listed in R-1 to R-4, so a use variance is the path there.

value.note: Tenant house as an accessory use, 'provided that the lot is not less than four acres'. For tenant farmers or farm or estate employees only.
Undefined residential uses 'shall only be allowed in the R-6 or PA Districts' and 'only be approved as a conditional use'. Needs a Zoning Officer determination first. Reading.

district_paths.note: AC path is the tenant house rule. R-6 and PA path is the new or undefined use rule, read as reaching a second unit.

value.condition: AC tenant house: 'provided that the lot is not less than four acres'.
AC tenant house: a residence 'for one or more tenant farmers or employees of a farm or estate'.
AC tenant house: the lot is restricted against further subdivision unless the tenant house could meet Chapter 255.
AC: a tenant house is 'an accessory building'. A unit inside or attached to the house is not a tenant house.
AC accessory structures: 20 ft from a side or rear property line and 10 ft from the house. 20 ft high.
R-4 accessory structures: 3 ft from a side or rear property line (10 ft in R-1 to R-3).
A rented unit needs an annual rental license from the township, with inspections.

setback_side_ft.note: 'not ... closer than 10 feet from a side or rear property line' in R-1 to R-3. R-4 3 ft. AC 20 ft.
